comments.text:
It's so unfair! All these cool places are in counties that have been around for thousands and millions of years, so like, of course they're gonna have all these places that took centuries to form themselves! Why did I have to grow up in stupid, boring, young AF United States where we don't have any of this cool ancient shit cuz the oldest stuff we have here is from like, the 17/1800's and it's just like log cabins and Plymouth rock and stuff (which, btw, is no where NEAR as big as you'd think it'd be! But I guess people have been chipping pieces off it for years, but still). Anyway, I guess Niagara Falls is pretty dope. So I've heard. I've never been there. 

😉😂
